name: aurasound-extraction-service
description: Internal YouTube Audio Stream Extraction Microservice for AuraSound

scripts.install-ytdlp: curl -fsSL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yt-dlp && yt-dlp --version || echo 'yt-dlp install skipped (no root access)'
